I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 10 June, not 25 November.

- **Where that comes from:** Ilse first posted 25 November in #north-team on 14 October. Right after, in #north-random, she corrected it to 10 June and said she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is in both channels, so he can see both posts. I haven't found anything since that changes the date.
- **One mistake in my reply:** I said she corrected it "later that day," but both posts were at 09:00 on the 14th.
- **What I couldn't check:** the knowledge brain (gbrain) is still refusing searches because its access token isn't tied to anyone. So I couldn't compare the date with any contract or account notes there. I suggested Marcus confirm with Ilse before the sheet goes out.
- **Out of date in #north-team:** my 14 October reply to Ilse there still says 25 November. I haven't corrected it.
